questions.description: 函数格式化输出学生信息。
函数返回多个计算结果。
questions.code_template:
def circle(r):
    area = 3.14159 * r * r
    circumference = 2 * 3.14159 * r
    return area, circumference

a, c = circle(1)
print(___, round(c, 2))
questions.solution:
def circle(r):
    area = 3.14159 * r * r
    circumference = 2 * 3.14159 * r
    return area, circumference

a, c = circle(1)
print(round(a, 2), round(c, 2))

questions.description: 函数求两数较大者（三元）。
函数返回字符重复次数。

questions.code_template:
def stats(scores):
    total = sum(scores)
    avg = total / len(scores)
    return total, avg

t, a = stats([80, 90, 70])
print(___)
questions.solution:
def stats(scores):
    total = sum(scores)
    avg = total / len(scores)
    return total, avg

t, a = stats([80, 90, 70])
print(f"Total: {t}, Avg: {a}")
